correctness.rationale: For each index i, marked Poisson thinning gives reset rate r(1-w_i)>0 and a unique stationary construction. At a stationary observation time the most recent global event has independent exponential age G and exempt label J; its single unreset coordinate adds a conditional exponential H of rate r(1-w_J). The exact multivariate age MGF factors into a common exponential term and a one-index-excess term. Differentiating its logarithm in distinct parameters gives (k-1)!/r^k times the stated signed odds product. Conditional Gaussian positions reproduce every distinct-index subset moment of the ages, hence their mixed cumulants. A product of arithmetic-geometric-mean bounds proves the sharp correction envelope and all equality/boundary claims. Generator/set-partition exact rational verification passed 798 cases; it is not relied on for universal validity.

value.rationale: Selective resetting with unequal exclusion frequencies models heterogeneous exposure/control of noninteracting colloids. The all-order theorem shows that every even-order absolute connected energy-like fluctuation is suppressed while every odd order beyond one is enhanced relative to the same-rate fully synchronized protocol, despite pair correlations alone suggesting uniform suppression. The exact sharp (k-1)^(-k) cap characterizes the maximum possible departure across all allowed weight vectors and dimensions, including equality and nonattainment regimes. The separate mean-normalized formula prevents conflating absolute and standardized correlation strengths. These are structural, measurable multibody consequences beyond computing another pair correlation; no general downstream theorem is asserted.
